kicker: Antidoom and Final Token Preference Optimization

scenes.headline: How to train a small model out of doom loops
scenes.sub: Final Token Preference Optimization retrains one position: where the loop restarts.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Radish! Small reasoning models sometimes repeat the same span until the context runs out. Liquid AI trains that away. Here's how.

scenes.text: Retrain only the token where a loop would restart: push the loop token down, lift several alternatives, and pin the rest of the vocabulary.
scenes.mark: only the token where a loop would restart
scenes.say: The idea: retrain only the position where a loop would restart. Push that token down, lift several alternatives, and pin everything else.

items.say: Tokens like Wait and So carry inflated priors, and under uncertainty they dominate.
Once a span is in context, it gets more likely, until the whole span is locked in near one.
At low temperature the model takes the top token, and there's almost no probability left anywhere else.

left.title: Plain DPO
items: Prefers one whole response over another
Anchored to the reference through the softmax
left.say: Plain DPO prefers one whole response over another, with one chosen and one rejected answer.

right.title: FTPO
items: Several chosen tokens share the freed probability
Anchored in logit space; the rest stays pinned
right.say: FTPO trains one trailing token, spreads the freed probability over several chosen tokens, and anchors in logit space, so the rest stays put.

steps.say: Generate at low temperature on prompts that tend to loop. Flag any section that repeats four times, over sixty characters.
The first token of the first repeat is rejected. Up to twenty plausible top-k alternatives become the chosen set.

steps.note: over-training past the stopping point spawns new loops
steps.say: Train on those rows with a LoRA, and stop early: over-training degrades the model and spawns new loops.

scenes.title: Doom-loop rate at temperature 0
scenes.note: the win is at low temperature and fades by 1.0
scenes.say: Under greedy decoding, loops fall from ten point two to one point four percent, and from twenty-two point nine to one. Answers the model knew now finish.

scenes.text: Fix the one position that restarts the loop, share the escape across several tokens, and leave everything else alone.
scenes.mark: the one position that restarts the loop

recap: Inflated priors, self-reinforcement and greedy decoding
FTPO retrains only the restart token
Several escapes; the rest of the vocabulary pinned
scenes.say: To recap: find the token that restarts the loop, lower it, lift several escapes, and pin the rest.
